nodes.natural_language: Substitute the expressions from tc_1 and tc_2 into the equations of tc_3 to obtain the system (5/8)b = (2/3)a + 7 and (3/8)b = (1/3)a + 7.
Multiply the first equation by 24 and the second by 24 to clear denominators, yielding 15b = 16a + 168 and 9b = 8a + 168.
Subtract the second simplified equation from the first to obtain 6b = 8a, hence b = (4/3)a.
Subtracting the two equations from l7 yields (1/4)b = (1/3)a, hence b = (4/3)a.
Substitute b = (4/3)a into the second equation of l7 to obtain 9*(4/3)a = 8a + 168, hence 12a = 8a + 168, so a = 42.
